spans.s: पुच्छ r. 1st cl. (पुच्छति) To err, to be careless or inattentive. भ्वा० पर० अक० सेट् ।

पुच्छ mn. (-च्छः-च्छं)
 1. A tail, the tail, the hinder part.
 2. A horse's
tail.
 3. The tail of the peacock.
 4. Any hairy tail.
 5. The end
of anything.
 E. पुच्छ to be careless, अच् aff.
पुच्छजाह n. (-हं) The root of the tail.

पुच्छटि(टी) f. (-टि or टी) Snapping or cracking the fingers. E.
पुच्छ-अटि वा ङीप् ।

पुच्छिन् mfn. (-च्छी-च्छिनी-च्छि) Having a tail.
 m. (-च्छी) A cock.
 E. पुच्छ a tail, and इनि aff.
